description: This file defines data models related to videos, including a VideoItem class for describing individual video sources and a DemoVideos class containing some curated sample videos with metadata, including local assets and streaming URLs.

classes.name: VideoItem
classes.description: A model class representing a video source with associated metadata such as title, asset path, network URL, and poster image.

classes.name: DemoVideos
classes.description: A utility class containing curated static instances of VideoItem representing sample videos, including Big Buck Bunny, Sintel, and Tears of Steel.

methods.name: isNetwork
methods.description: A getter that determines if the VideoItem's source is a network URL based on the presence and non-emptiness of the url field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides the default string representation of VideoItem, displaying its title, asset, and URL.
